commit.message:
fix(static): restore rollback from retained publication (w4/m197)

A static_site rollback extracted the target's image through today's saved
publish directory, so a bad saved directory made every rollback fail.

- operator records each successful publish's object-store prefix per
  generation (<app>-static-r<gen>), backfilling the outgoing served one
- releaseConfig.staticPrefix selects a retained publication; image is now
  optional (CEL: image or staticPrefix)
- publish Job gains a retained-copy mode: aws-cli `fetch` syncs the prefix,
  fails named on empty/unreadable source, upload copies to the new revision
- bex-api Rollback selects the record for static sites (built and direct),
  refuses unrecorded targets with a named 409 before dispatch; the
  capability projection makes the same check
- saved build/publish settings and BuildCommit stay unchanged
